description: User story under REQ-180 for the command page (discovery sections 4 rank 5, 6, 11 and 14; FBS-206). The chip row and the stage detail become one stage grid above the fold (D1 to D8 by tree and delta scope, pass/total per cell, failing count linked into the blocking table). The panel is split into five sub-tabs through the shared SubTabStrip with sub= in the hash, restored after an SSE swap. The delta on an unfrozen tree is counts with an on-demand per-document list (Q2). The For-engineers DocRow wrapper is removed and every engineer item survives in a named table or block. The freeze block shows the state and what resolves it in words (Q4). Sub-tabs are the designed shape; one long page with anchor navigation is the named alternative ruled on the rendered sketches (Q5).
asA: an engineer opening the Readiness tab on a large unfrozen tree
iWant: the stage states as a grid above the fold, the page split into sub-views, and the delta as counts rather than every document in the tree
soThat: the command page loads light, reads top-down and never buries the failing ids under a thousand delta rows

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given readiness.stages, when the overview sub-view renders, then a stage grid shows each stage as a row and the scopes "tree" and "delta" as columns, each VerdictGridCell carrying VerdictGridCell.pass, VerdictGridCell.total and VerdictGridCell.state, with VerdictGridCell.failing rendered as a link into the blocking table filtered to that stage.

[happy] Given the Readiness tab, when it renders, then a SubTabStrip offers "Overview", "Questions", "Blocking", "Coverage" and "Trace", the active key is written into the hash as sub=, and the router restores it on load and after an SSE innerHTML swap of #rcf-live-content.

[happy] Given an unfrozen tree, when the delta block renders, then DeltaCounts.changed, DeltaCounts.added, DeltaCounts.removed, DeltaCounts.briefSince, DeltaCounts.impacted and DeltaCounts.impactedFbs render as numbers and the per-document list with its diff widgets renders only after the reader expands the details element (DeltaCounts.expanded true).

[happy] Given the profile register is "engineer", when the tab renders, then the For-engineers DocRow wrapper is absent and every engineer item (failing ids with why, next action, stage states, coverage counts, decisions outstanding, freeze state) is present in a named table or block of the sub-views.

[happy] Given ready-to-build is "no", when the freeze block renders, then it names each failing gate in plain words with what resolves it, with no button and no command text; given ready-to-build is "yes", it states that the tree can be frozen and what a freeze would record.

[edge] Given a stage acknowledged at the current tree hash, when the grid renders, then VerdictGridCell.state is "acknowledged" and the reason shows on hover, read from stages[].state and one reason helper rather than from freezeRecord.gates directly.

[must-not] Given embed mode (data-embed="1") and a viewport narrower than 720px, when the Readiness tab renders, then no table forces horizontal page scroll: tables collapse to stacked rows and the SubTabStrip stays inside the panel.
[failure] Given a hash whose sub= value is not a known readiness sub-tab key, when the router runs, then the overview sub-view is activated and the unknown value is dropped from the hash.

title: the Readiness tab is laid out as a stage grid with sub-tabs and delta counts, the For-engineers row retired
